_comment: ALL economy values live here so you can balance without code edits. Sections tagged (M5)/(M6) are read by later milestones; values are final-format already.

biomass._comment: In-run currency. Alien corpses hold Biomass; harvester drones collect it within range of a Harvester Bay. Charred (incendiary-killed) and eaten corpses yield nothing.

upgrade_costs._comment: [cost to tier II, cost to tier III]

harvester._comment: Per Harvester Bay tier (I, II, III). capacity = Biomass a drone carries before flying home.

xenite._comment: (M6) Persistent ore paid out at the end of every run, win or lose.

threat._comment: (M5) Threat Level multiplier rises each wave and multiplies the Xenite payout.

hazard_contracts._comment: (M6) Optional modifiers chosen before a run. xenite_bonus is additive (+0.25 = +25%).

recruit._comment: Workers are recruited at the Command Hab, soldiers trained at a Barracks.

wages_per_wave._comment: Paid after every wave. Unpaid wages drop morale: crews and soldiers fire 20% slower next wave.

wave_bounty._comment: Company resupply after every wave survived, x Threat Level.

xenite_sale._comment: Mined Xenite is bought by the company after every wave: Biomass per unit; contract_share is banked for the Colony Charter (M6).

repair._comment: Worker repair rate (HP per second per worker). Costs repair_cost_per_hp Biomass per HP.

construction._comment: Worker build speed (work-seconds per second per worker).
